title: Jacobi output encoding
statement: For a Boolean list $S$, inspect the second component of its second decoded component. If the encoding of the first component of that second decoded component, paired with the one-element list $[\mathrm{true}]$, passes the Boolean test, return the empty list when the inspected component defaults to false, and otherwise return $[\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}]$. If the test fails, return $[\mathrm{true}]$.
caveat: The pairing, default-decoding, and Boolean-test operations are not defined in the supplied payload; in particular, the exact test being applied is unclear.
